findings.trigger: Transactions with categories (e.g. grocery, retail) or country codes passed to SHAP/LIME
findings.intended_semantics: Feature vectors passed to explainer model predict_fn must be 100% identical to training and prediction path
findings.actual_behavior: Duplicate ad-hoc encoding with arbitrary 8-category/10-country vocabularies and hardcoded scaling created feature drift between model inference and explanation
findings.root_cause: Duplicated, un-synchronized preprocessing implementations across services
findings.explanation_impact: Severe (explainer perturbed feature dimensions at wrong scales and category offsets)
findings.user_visible_impact: Attributions attributed risk to wrong categories and scaled values
findings.proof: Comparing _parse_transaction_features output with preprocess_transaction showed offset category values
findings.repair_strategy: Consolidate into canonical preprocess_transaction in data_generator.py and delegate directly

findings.intended_semantics: Explainer must receive and evaluate the exact active serving model instance
findings.actual_behavior: Endpoint did not pass model to compute_shap_values, relying on disk checkpoint loading that could diverge from active serving model
findings.root_cause: Omission of model argument passing in predict router
findings.explanation_impact: Risk of explaining stale disk weights instead of active model
findings.user_visible_impact: Mismatched explanations on dynamic model promotion or hot-swap
findings.proof: Code inspection of explain_transaction showed compute_shap_values(txn_dict) called without model parameter

findings.trigger: Fast heuristic explanation or SHAP fallback heuristic execution
findings.intended_semantics: Method must truthfully report its actual algorithmic nature (fast_heuristic, fallback_heuristic)
findings.actual_behavior: FastInferenceExplainer returned shap_values key and COMPUTED source; predict router summary reported SHAP even when fallback_heuristic ran
findings.explanation_impact: Heuristic explanations masqueraded as exact game-theoretic SHAP attributions
findings.user_visible_impact: Users informed that SHAP ran when heuristic fallback had executed
findings.proof: test_shap_additivity_axiom showed fallback_heuristic returned with summary claiming SHAP
findings.repair_strategy: Explicitly report method='fast_heuristic' and method='fallback_heuristic' in payload and response summary

findings.trigger: Alert generation and forensic feature inspection
findings.intended_semantics: value field must represent the actual feature value (e.g. amount=4500.0) while contribution represents the attribution score
findings.actual_behavior: Line 732 set 'value': round(f['contribution'], 4), completely clobbering the raw feature value with its contribution score
findings.explanation_impact: Raw feature values destroyed in top_features JSON
findings.user_visible_impact: Alert card displayed contribution score as feature value (e.g. amount: 0.12 instead of $4500)
findings.repair_strategy: Set 'value' to the true raw feature value from f.get('raw_value', txn.get(f['feature']))

findings.trigger: Querying GNN explanation for historical alerts
findings.intended_semantics: GNN explanation must be bound to graph state as of historical alert.created_at
findings.actual_behavior: explain_gnn_embedding queried latest graph state without as_of cutoff, allowing future edges to leak into historical explanations
findings.root_cause: Missing temporal cutoff parameter in explain_gnn_embedding
findings.explanation_impact: Future transaction edges leaked into historical graph attributions
findings.user_visible_impact: Graph explanation showed edges that did not exist when alert was raised
findings.repair_strategy: Add as_of parameter to explain_gnn_embedding and pass alert.created_at in router

findings.trigger: Rendering risk-decreasing features or contributions in UI
findings.intended_semantics: Directional sign and magnitude bar width must continuously represent mathematical contribution
findings.actual_behavior: Predictor hardcoded + sign (+-15%); AlertsPage used discontinuous step barWidth (pct * 5 for <25%) giving 20% contribution a 100% bar
findings.explanation_impact: Sign confusion and distorted visual proportions in dashboard
findings.user_visible_impact: Risk-reducing features styled as risk-increasing; smaller contributions given 5x wider bars than larger ones
findings.repair_strategy: Implement directional +/- sign, emerald/rose styling, and continuous Math.min(100, Math.max(3, abs(contrib)*100)) magnitude bars
findings.tests: Verified via visual code inspection and frontend build check

findings.capability: Tenant Isolation in Realtime Explainer Cache
findings.trigger: Cross-tenant explanation requests for identical transaction IDs
findings.intended_semantics: Cache keys must include tenant_id to prevent cross-tenant explanation leakage
findings.actual_behavior: Cache key was cfi:shap:{transaction_id} with no tenant namespace
findings.root_cause: Missing tenant_id parameter in cache key builder
findings.explanation_impact: Potential cache collision across banks in multi-tenant SaaS mode
findings.user_visible_impact: Bank B could retrieve cached explanation computed for Bank A
findings.proof: realtime_explainer.py cache key construction was f'cfi:shap:{transaction_id}'
findings.repair_strategy: Update cache key to cfi:shap:{tenant_id}:{transaction_id} and add invalidate_cache

findings.trigger: Passing NaN or Inf in transaction payload
findings.intended_semantics: Fail closed and raise ValueError on non-finite input; reject non-finite attributions
findings.actual_behavior: nan_to_num replaced NaN with 1e30, causing floating point overflow in PyTorch MLP
findings.root_cause: Permissive nan_to_num substitution instead of fail-closed input validation
findings.explanation_impact: Numerical instability during neural network forward pass
findings.proof: Passing float('nan') in test produced overflow errors
findings.repair_strategy: Enforce strict fail-closed validation via preprocess_transaction and assert np.all(np.isfinite(shap_matrix))

findings.capability: Explainer Cache Background & Feature Schema Identity
findings.trigger: Baseline reference population values change while model object and row count remain identical
findings.intended_semantics: Explainer cache key must incorporate background content digest and feature schema to prevent stale explainer reuse across different reference distributions
findings.actual_behavior: Cache key was (id(model), baseline.shape[0]), which blindfolded the cache to baseline values and feature ordering
findings.root_cause: Omission of content fingerprint and feature schema in explainer cache key
findings.explanation_impact: Explainer reuse across different reference baselines resulted in mismatched expected_values and attribution shifts
findings.user_visible_impact: Inconsistent baseline risk expectations and biased SHAP attributions
findings.proof: Two distinct backgrounds of shape (30, 10) (e.g. zeros vs 0.85s) returned the identical cached explainer with stale expected_value 0.046 instead of 0.85
findings.repair_strategy: Strengthen cache key to (model_key, id(model), tuple(FEATURE_NAMES), baseline.shape, baseline_fp) using SHA-256 fingerprint of baseline bytes

findings.trigger: Re-explaining a transaction after feature enrichment mutation, model promotion, or as_of change
findings.intended_semantics: Cached explanation results must be bound to model_version, as_of timestamp, and feature vector fingerprint
findings.actual_behavior: compute_shap and explain_async only keyed cache by cfi:shap:{tenant_id}:{transaction_id}, allowing stale explanations to survive feature mutations
findings.root_cause: Omission of feature_fingerprint, model_version, and as_of parameters in domain explainer cache key building
findings.explanation_impact: Mutated or enriched transaction features returned stale pre-mutation explanations from cache
findings.user_visible_impact: Investigation UI showed out-of-date explanations when features changed while transaction ID was preserved
findings.proof: test_explanation_cache_separated_by_feature_state and test_explanation_cache_separated_by_model_version showed stale cache hits without feature fingerprint
findings.repair_strategy: Incorporate model_version, as_of, and feature vector SHA-256 fingerprint into key: cfi:shap:{tenant_id}:{transaction_id}:m_{model_version}:t_{as_of}:f_{feature_fingerprint}
